_readme: Per-card labels from the archived sparkcapital.com listings, years [2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020]: WordPress /companies/ 2015-2017 (sector, geography and a seed/venture/growth class per card, per-company pages), the 2018-2019 WordPress redesign (sector sections, seed/venture/growth class, website links) and the 2020 B12 site (tag-sector-*, tag-stage-*; 'alumni' = exited). Generated by scratch/wp-listing-tags.py from the wayback-pull raw snapshots. The stage class describes the company as listed, not the entry round (COLLECTION.md §6): scored on the gate before it may corroborate.
